Triage: graded `pm:on-hold` (2026-08-19, triage seat, first-touch). Reason: the re-key cannot land until the locally pinned `@objectstack/spec` publishes `storage` as a `CoreServiceName` member — doing it now fails the #4240 tripwire against the real installed types, and the current alias-table shape (#5286) is correct and fully test-covered. Source: seat grading — S-level cleanup, zero user impact today; framework keeps the `file-storage` mirror row for all of v17 either way.

Restart-when: `node -e "process.exit(require('@objectstack/spec/system').CoreServiceName.options.includes('storage')?0:1)"` exits 0 in an objectui checkout (i.e. after the next spec pin bump) — then re-queue: re-key `SERVICE_ENDPOINT_CATALOG`, delete `DEPRECATED_SERVICE_SLOT_ALIASES` and its special-cased lookup, invert the tripwire assertions per the card body.

(Restart-when carried in this comment per the body-sanitizer discipline — the hold-predicate sub-round reads comments newer than the body.)

## 解除挂起 → `pm:queue` · `priority:p3` —— 重开条件已满足:本仓安装的 spec 17.4.0 已发布 `storage` 服务位

分诊席(`session_01Tw7jnJinGHvoGSi8aFkhPJ`,objectstack 座位贴 #6015),2026-09-24T01:34Z。objectui 清理第一批:本席逐张读完卡面与全部评论,把结论与理由报给维护者,维护者答复后执行。 维护者答:「5291 放回队列」。

### 读数

- objectui 的 `pnpm-lock.yaml` 解析到 `@objectstack/spec@17.4.0`。本席取了 17.4.0 的发布包(`npm pack`):`dist/system/index.d.ts` 的 `CoreServiceName` 已含 `storage`,同时仍保留 `file-storage`。⇒ 本卡 `5342583572` 写下的 `Restart-when:` 探针会退出 0。
- `apps/console/src/pages/developer/hooks/useApiDiscovery.ts` 在 `origin/main` 上仍以 `'file-storage'` 为键(`:225`),并保留 `DEPRECATED_SERVICE_SLOT_ALIASES`(`:252`)。⇒ 改键尚未做。

### 交付(照卡面)

把 `SERVICE_ENDPOINT_CATALOG` 的 `'file-storage'` 改键为 `'storage'`;删除 `DEPRECATED_SERVICE_SLOT_ALIASES` 及 `discover()` 里的特判;反转 `useApiDiscovery.test.ts` 里的 tripwire 断言。无用户可见变化,纯清理 ⇒ `p3`。
